heard: This is the family history of Esau That is Edom in the hill country of Seir He took his wives from the daughters of Canaan Adon, Do, Halibama and Basemath came Their possessions were too great to live together The land could not support their livestock So Esau settled in the hill country of Seir Esau was Edom, the father of the Adomites Chief Byron stands in the list of the chiefs.
